html:
The Antakirinja are an Aboriginal Australian people of northern South Australia, around present-day Coober Pedy. The map shows them as Antakarinja from 1600 to 1815. They speak a dialect of the Western Desert language and belong to the Western Desert cultural bloc.

Their neighbours were the Arabana to the east, the Kokatha to the south and the Yankunytjatjara to the northwest. Opal was found at Coober Pedy in 1915, and the mining town that grew there brought many outsiders. Today the Antakirinja Matu-Yankunytjatjara people hold native title over a large area around the town.
